Air ambulance with 6 aboard vanishes off US coast, search underway

An air ambulance carrying six people has vanished off the coast of Nantucket, Massachusetts, prompting a search by the U.S. Coast Guard. The aircraft, which was en route from Bermuda to Boston, lost communication with flight controllers after a significant drop in altitude, according to flight data. The plane is reported to be Ontario-owned, and the company confirmed four Canadian staff were aboard.
